Commentary.Commentary: We are back with the chase. Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie walk out as the openers for Ireland. Fazalhaq Farooqi will bowl the first over for Afghanistan.
... RUN CHASE ...

Bowling from Ireland was spot on, to begin with but they failed to capitalize on a terrific start and gave away plenty in the death overs. The side got rid of the top order in a jiffy and managed to break through the batting order of Afghanistan only for Nabi and Rashid Khan to hurt them. Mark Adair was the pick of the bowlers as he picked up three while Joshua Little and Barry McCarthy picked up a couple each. Ben White took a solitary wicket as well. The target id a good one looking at the two-paced surface and the quality of bowling that Afghanistan possesses. Can Ireland seal the series with a win today or will Afghanistan stay alive in this series? We will find that out with the chasing coming up in a while.

After electing to bat first, Afghanistan started horribly and were 14 for 4 inside 4 overs. Mohammad Nabi along with Sediqullah Atal then put up a partnership of 79 runs that turned the tables for them and put them in a good position to capitalize the last few overs. The side lost Ijaz Ahmadzai and Mohammad Nabi in quick succession again but a late surge by Rashid Khan with the bat helped them get past 150. Mohammad Nabi scored a half-century and was brilliant with the bat. Sediqullah Atal scored 35 while Rashid Khan was off the hook in a flash and played a gem of a cameo of 25 runs.
Experience came to aid Afghanistan as they recovered phenomenally from being 14 for 4 to scoring 152.
Yorker in middle, Fazalhaq Farooqi thumps this wide of the bowler for a single to end the innings. Afghanistan scores 152 after 20 overs.

Commentary.Commentary: We are set for play to begin. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Sediqullah Atal walk out as the openers for Afghanistan while Mark Adair will bowl the first over for Ireland.

Skipper of Ireland Paul Stirling says he is happy to lose the toss as he wasn't sure what to do. Adds that they want to continue the winning momentum and will start afresh today. Informs about the only change with Neil Rock making space for George Dockrell.

Skipper of Afghanistan Rashid Khan elects to bat first and says that the conditions will remain the same throughout so they would like runs on board and will try to defend that. Adds they have a very good bowling lineup that is capable of defending any total. Informs they are unchanged for this game.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Ibrahim Zadran, Sediqullah Atal, Ijaz Ahmadzai, Azmatullah Omarzai, Mohammad Ishaq, Mohammad Nabi, Nangeyalia Kharote, Rashid Khan (C), Naveen-ul-Haq, Fazalhaq Farooqi.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie (C), Lorcan Tucker (WK), Harry Tector, Curtis Campher, George Dockrell, Gareth Delany, Mark Adair, Barry McCarthy, Joshua Little, Ben White.
TOSS - Afghanistan have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Ireland on the other hand now stands a chance to seal the series with a victory tonight. The bowlers did a tremendous job in the first game and won them the first game of this series. Ben White and Joshua Little in particular were unplayable for the Afghan batters. The side has quality players amongst the squad, and they would be looking to improve their batting performance and continue working wonders with their bowlers. Can Ireland take a 2-nil lead in the series or will Afghanistan bounce back and level it? we shall find out soon. Toss and team updates to follow ...

Afghanistan are trailing in this series 0-1 as they lost the first game by 38 runs. The batting order of Afghanistan failed miserably in the first game and the side couldn't even chase 149. The side though has the artillery in their arsenal to come bounce back. Players like Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Ibrahim Zadran, Azmatullah Omarzai and Mohammad Nabi are good enough with the bat. The bowling attack did well in the previous game and they would be looking for another solid performance from the bowlers. Rashid Khan on his return was unplayable for the Irish batters and he was well-helped by Nangeyalia Kharote. The side needs to get better at chasing and the batting order will have to step up if they are to level the series.
